newsitem.title: HUNGARY: BRITISH MAN KILLED, WIFE INJURED, IN HUNGARY ATTACK.
newsitem.headline: BRITISH MAN KILLED, WIFE INJURED, IN HUNGARY ATTACK.

text.p: A British man was clubbed to death and his wife was seriously injured when bandits attacked their broken-down caravan outside a small town in northeastern Hungary, police said.
Three men were later arrested as suspects, police said on Wednesday.

National police spokesman Mihaily Desi told the Hungarian television news that the British victim, identified as Michael Trevor Pollard, 63, and his wife Sovaleire, 55, a dual British-New Zealand national, were attacked early on Tuesday by men armed with iron clubs.
The couple, who were on their way to Romania, parked late at night near a bus stop outside the town after their car, pulling a trailer, broke down, newspapers said.
Police said the attackers first posed as policemen and approached the couple to demand fines of 2,000 forints each for parking illegally, which the couple paid.
They then returned to beat the couple and rob them, police said.
Desi said Pollard was killed in the attack while his wife was being treated in hospital for life-threatening injuries.
She awoke from a coma and stumbled to the road where a passing bread delivery van driver spotted her and drove her to hospital, police said.
Police declined to release the names of the suspects but said two of them were 22 years old and one was 18.
